text: During two years of thorough investigation, no evidence was found which would indicate
that the reported flying saucers were anything but the result of natural phenomena. On the
other hand, all the evidence indicated that the reports of unidentified flying objects
could be accounted for under three major headings. One, misinterpretation of various conventional
two, a mild form of hysteria, three, or simple hoaxes.
It has been suggested that what people actually have been seeing
is the result of some of our own secret experiments,

This is emphatically not the case.
